fullPassage: Surprisingly, some scientists interested in learning more about animal evolution and adaptation are moving their studies to the big cities. This is because animals in these areas must find ways to deal with life in an unusual environment. For example, some species of fish in a New York City river have evolved a resistance to a certain kind of toxic pollution. Along with evolution, urban animals also undergo behavioral changes to survive in big cities. Some, such as crows, have even found ways to use human technology to their advantage. When unable to open a hard nut, birds will usually drop them from great heights. But crows in Tokyo use an easier method: they place the nuts in the street and wait for passing cars to run them over.

questions.passage: Surprisingly, some scientists interested in learning more about animal evolution and adaptation are moving their studies to the big cities. This is because animals in these areas must find ways to deal with life in an (A)[unusual / familiar] environment. For example, some species of fish in a New York City river have evolved a resistance to a certain kind of (B)[harmless / toxic] pollution. Along with evolution, urban animals also undergo behavioral changes to survive in big cities. Some, such as crows, have even found ways to use human technology to their advantage. When unable to open a hard nut, birds will usually drop them from great heights. But crows in Tokyo use an (C)[easier / harder] method: they place the nuts in the street and wait for passing cars to run them over.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) unusual=특이한, (B) toxic=독성의, (C) easier=더 쉬운
det.analysis:
✅ ① unusual — toxic — easier — 원문 일치 ←정답

❌ ② familiar(익숙한) — toxic — easier: (A) 도시는 동물에게 '특이한(unusual)' 환경이므로 unusual. familiar는 반대

❌ ③ unusual — harmless(무해한) — easier: (B) 물고기가 '독성(toxic)' 오염에 내성을 진화시켰으므로 toxic. harmless는 반대

❌ ④ unusual — toxic — harder(더 어려운): (C) 도쿄 까마귀는 '더 쉬운(easier)' 방법을 쓰므로 easier. harder는 반대
det.tip: unusual(특이한) ↔ familiar(익숙한), toxic(독성의) ↔ harmless(무해한), easy(쉬운) ↔ hard(어려운)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) evolved=진화시켰다, (B) behavioral=행동의, (C) advantage=이점
det.analysis:
❌ ① lost(잃었다) — behavioral — advantage: (A) 물고기가 오염에 대한 내성을 '진화시켰다(evolved)'이므로 evolved. lost는 반대

✅ ② evolved — behavioral — advantage — 원문 일치 ←정답

❌ ③ evolved — physical(신체적인) — advantage: (B) 진화(신체적 변화)와 '더불어' 겪는 것은 '행동의(behavioral)' 변화이므로 behavioral. physical은 중복·반대 맥락

❌ ④ evolved — behavioral — disadvantage(불리함): (C) 까마귀가 기술을 '이점(advantage)'으로 활용하므로 advantage. disadvantage는 반대
det.tip: evolve(진화하다) ↔ lose(잃다), behavioral(행동의) ↔ physical(신체적인), advantage(이점) ↔ disadvantage(불리함)

❌ ③ reproduction(번식) — 자손을 낳는 것이지 점진적 변화 과정이 아님

✅ ④ evolution(진화) ←정답 — 여러 세대에 걸친 점진적 발달·변화 과정
det.tip: over many generations, develop and change = evolution(진화)

questions.passage: Surprisingly, some scientists interested in learning more about animal evolution and adaptation are __________ (move) their studies to the big cities. This is because animals in these areas must find ways to deal with life in an unusual environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: be동사(are) 뒤 진행형 → move → moving. '옮기고 있다'는 현재진행
det.analysis:
'are __________ (move)'는 be동사 뒤 현재진행형 자리

be + V-ing 형태 필요 → move → moving

따라서 빈칸에는 moving
det.tip: be + V-ing 현재진행: move → moving

questions.passage: Along with evolution, urban animals also undergo __________ (behave) changes to survive in big cities. Some, such as crows, have even found ways to use human technology to their advantage.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 명사 changes 앞은 형용사 자리 → behave(동사) → behavioral(형용사): 행동의
det.analysis:
'undergo __________ (behave) changes'에서 명사 changes를 꾸미는 형용사 자리

behave(행동하다, 동사) → behavioral(행동의, 형용사)

따라서 빈칸에는 behavioral
det.tip: 동사 behave → 형용사 behavioral: 행동의. behavioral changes(행동 변화)

questions.passage: Surprisingly, some scientists interested in learning more about animal evolution and adaptation are moving their studies to the big cities. This is because animals in these areas must find ways __________ life in an unusual environment. For example, some species of fish in a New York City river have evolved a resistance to a certain kind of toxic pollution. Along with evolution, urban animals also undergo behavioral changes to survive in big cities. Some, such as crows, have even found ways to use human technology to their advantage. When unable to open a hard nut, birds will usually drop them from great heights. But crows in Tokyo use an easier method: they place the nuts in the street and wait for passing cars to run them over.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정답: to deal with(~에 대처하다). 특이한 환경 속 삶에 '대처할' 방법을 찾음
det.analysis:
❌ ① to escape from(~에서 도망치다) — 삶에서 도망치는 게 아니라 대처하는 것

✅ ② to deal with(~에 대처하다) ←정답 — 'find ways ____ life in an unusual environment'는 삶에 '대처할' 방법을 찾는다는 뜻

❌ ③ to give up(포기하다) — 생존 노력과 반대

❌ ④ to laugh at(비웃다) — 문맥 무관
det.tip: find ways to deal with ~ = ~에 대처할 방법을 찾다

questions.passage: Surprisingly, some scientists interested in learning more about animal evolution and adaptation are moving their studies to the big cities. When unable to open a hard nut, birds will usually drop them __________. But crows in Tokyo use an easier method: they place the nuts in the street and wait for passing cars to run them over.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정답: from great heights(높은 곳에서). 단단한 견과를 깨려고 '높은 곳에서' 떨어뜨림
det.analysis:
❌ ① into the nearby water(근처 물속으로) — 견과를 깨는 방법과 무관

❌ ② onto the soft grass(부드러운 풀밭 위로) — 부드러운 곳에 떨어뜨리면 깨지지 않음

✅ ③ from great heights(높은 곳에서) ←정답 — 단단한 견과를 못 열 때 '높은 곳에서' 떨어뜨려 깬다는 뜻. 이어서 도쿄 까마귀의 더 쉬운 방법과 대비됨

❌ ④ beside their nests(둥지 옆에서) — 낮은 곳이라 견과가 깨지지 않아 부적절
det.tip: drop them from great heights = 높은 곳에서 떨어뜨리다 (충격으로 견과를 깸)
